Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Damodar Prasad Tiwary, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 15-05-2024

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is husband of opposite party no. 2 and cognizance against the petitioner has been taken under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Learned counsel further submits that there is chance of reconciliation in the matter.

In the circumstances issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 under ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites must be filed within six weeks, failing which the petition will be dismissed.

In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Turkauliya (Banjariya) Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.29667 of 2024(2) dt.15-05-2024 P.S. Case No. 640 of 2020 pending in the Court of C.J.M., Motihari, East Champaran.
